Perfect! All tests pass (210 passing, 0 failing). I've successfully implemented the overdue invoice report feature:

## Summary

Created two new files:

**`src/reports.js`** — Contains the `overdueInvoices` function that:
- Filters invoices with status `'issued'` or `'partially_paid'`
- Filters those with `dueDate` before the given `asOf` date
- Returns an array of objects with: `{ number, customerId, dueDate, daysOverdue, due }`
- Sorts by most overdue first (highest `daysOverdue` first)

**`test/reports.test.js`** — 26 comprehensive tests covering:
- Empty arrays and no overdue invoices
- Filtering by status (excludes draft and paid)
- Filtering by due date (before asOf, but not on the due date itself)
- Sorting behavior
- Calculation of days overdue and due amounts
- Various payment terms (NET14, NET30, EOM)
- Edge cases (year boundaries, same due dates, large invoices)
- Input immutability

The implementation correctly handles all invoice states and payment scenarios, and all 210 tests (including existing tests) pass successfully.
